digest.component_or_area: opcert signing and enforcement (MCP container + verify-opcert gate)
propositions: The MCP container must be provisioned to sign plan-review and completion-verifier op-certs under the existing pinned environment 9f1c8e42-7a3b-4d5e-b6c1-2f0a9d8e7c65 by binding the composed signer (principal + materialized Ed25519 key) at startup within the uvicorn context.

A container-minted op-cert must verify against the pinned public key in .rebar/trusted_environments.yaml through the real verify_required_environment path, while a cert signed by an unregistered key must be rejected (positive and negative controls).

The enforce/grandfather mechanism must be proven against fixture configs such that tickets closed after an opcert_enforce_since boundary without valid completion-verifier certs fail verify-opcert (exit 1, enforced), while pre-boundary tickets pass as advisory (exit 0, grandfathered).
Unsetting verify.require_environment in fixture configs must return verify-opcert to advisory everywhere (exit 0) and preserve verification of existing opcert-minted certs (regression oracle).

The authoritative enforcement flip (setting verify.require_environment and verify.opcert_enforce_since in rebar.toml) must be deferred to a human-run operator runbook (infra/runbooks/mcp-opcert-enforcement-flip.md) and NOT committed in this stack, to avoid breaking local-CLI closes on the verify-identity merge-gate before the MCP signer is the live close path.
No new environment, key material, or entry in trusted_environments.yaml is created; the existing pinned environment and its public key are reused.
